D_same_set_of_worlds.verdict: `same_set_of_worlds` is a subset test on the 1-element box_blocked list, not on the two 639s. It is True for the empty list, so on the real corpus it is a test that {2302} is one of the 639 -- which _wider_box guarantees by construction, since it selects `silent` with the identical predicate _denominators uses. It can never fail on real data and is therefore not evidence for claim D.
D_same_set_of_worlds.what_the_field_compares: set(w['i'] for w in wider['box_blocked']['worlds']) <= set(r['i'] for r in silent_unreachable)
